description: Implement weapon drop physics (gravity + floor landing) and add collision to editor objects so items placed in the editor cannot pass through walls
steps: WEAPON DROP PHYSICS: In src/game/Combat.ts, modify the dropped weapons behavior. Currently in the update() method, dropped weapons rotate and bob up/down in a floating animation (line: dropped.position.y = 0.5 + Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.002) * 0.05). Replace this with actual physics: each dropped weapon should have a velocity stored in userData (userData.velocityY). On creation (createDroppedWeapon), set initial position.y to the drop height (currently 0.5, which is already low - for player drops use camera height minus some offset) and set userData.velocityY = 0. In update(), apply gravity to velocityY and update position.y. Clamp to floor at y=0.1 (weapon resting on ground). Once on the floor, stop applying gravity. Remove the floating/bobbing animation.

WEAPON DROP PHYSICS - MAP COLLISION: When a weapon is dropped, it should collide with map geometry (walls/floor) but NOT with the player. The game already has colliders in this.prisonMap.colliders (array of THREE.Box3). Pass these colliders to the Combat system. In Combat.update(), for each dropped weapon that is still falling, check if its bounding box intersects any map collider. If it does, stop movement in that direction. For simplicity: just do a vertical fall + horizontal velocity (throw direction), and stop vertical when hitting floor or a surface below.

WEAPON DROP PHYSICS - THROW DIRECTION: In dropWeapon(), give the weapon an initial horizontal velocity in the direction the player is looking (userData.velocityX, userData.velocityZ). Apply friction each frame to slow horizontal movement. Check horizontal collision against map colliders.

EDITOR OBJECT COLLISION: In src/editor/MapEditor.ts or src/editor/EditorObjects.ts, the objects placed in the editor do not generate colliders for the game. The user wants objects to have collision so items do not pass through walls. This requires that when a map is loaded/used in the game (via PrisonMapDetailed or the playtest mode), colliders are generated from placed objects. Look at src/editor/PlaytestMode.ts to understand how the editor map is played. Add collision box generation: for each placed object, compute a bounding box and add it to the colliders array that gets passed to FirstPersonController.setColliders(). In PlaytestMode.ts, after placing all objects, generate Box3 colliders from each object group and include them in the colliders list.
Ensure dropped weapons do NOT have player collision (the player should be able to walk through them to pick them up). Only map/wall collision applies to dropped weapons.
acceptance_criteria: Dropped weapons fall to the ground with gravity instead of floating
Dropped weapons stop at floor level (y ~ 0.1) or on top of surfaces
Dropped weapons collide with map walls (do not pass through)
Players can still walk through dropped weapons to pick them up
Editor-placed objects have collision in playtest mode
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit and verify no errors
Run npx vite build and verify build succeeds
findings: All changes compiled cleanly. Editor object collision was already implemented in PlaytestMode.ts via addColliders(). The weapon drop physics replaces the floating/bobbing animation with gravity, floor landing at y=0.1, horizontal throw velocity from camera direction, map wall collision using Box3 intersection tests, and friction. Players can still walk through dropped weapons since the weapons are not added to the player's collider list.
